initiative.title: Dependency graph legibility
initiative.summary: Make mid-level dependency views readable: group neighbors by module/package then file, make folders visibly distinct and size-aware, pack to a sane aspect ratio with spread-out edges, show LOC and the shared treemap color overlay, all without regressing performance.
initiative.next_action: Worker: m1 packing after quick-fix mA/mB merge

shared color overlay and peek/fly-in touch navigation
legend, header removal, hover bug land there first

claims.statement: Performance is the standout strength; no change may compromise load or drill speed.
Folders are visually indistinguishable from files; mixed folder/file views are muddled.
Folder boxes are larger and show a few summary lines: subfolders, files, LOC.
claims.supersedes: dependency-view C6 (uniform box size) for folder boxes

claims.statement: Relative size must read visually; a 276-file folder must look massive, not just carry a number.
Mid-level views come out as 4:1-7:1 strips; they should be compact and centered, using the viewport.
Edges all run through the same narrow channel; they should spread out so the graph can be read.
code_anchors: client/src/viz/deps/layout.ts:389 gutter next to anchor row

claims.statement: Group neighbors by module/package first, then by file or class, with a visible frame per group.
code_anchors: client/src/viz/deps/layout.ts:278,336-359 level sort + barycenter (would need group-contiguous ordering)

claims.statement: Symbol boxes use two or three lines (module, file, symbol) instead of truncating the important part.
Files as containers of symbols: a file exporting one symbol shows the symbol; busy containers render compact.
code_anchors: server/app/services/deps/graph.py:84-171 symbol nodes only when edge targets them

claims.statement: Show LOC on file nodes and ideally per symbol.
code_anchors: server/app/services/analysis.py:1145,1180 treemap path = absolute, joinable with absPath

claims.statement: One shared color overlay: the dependency graph respects the treemap color metric; treemap and graph are projections of the same data.
Preserve left-to-right flow and the narrow-focus views that already work well.
Peek / fly-in: expand a neighbor's contents in context without refocusing.
claims.notes: User doubted expand-in-place at 3:30 but asked again at 9:02.

claims.statement: Surface a folder's most-used items on the parent view (e.g. camera inside model-viz).
Dashed (faint neighbor-to-neighbor) edges may be too much in busy views.
Compare mode reuses layoutViewSync, so layout changes ripple into compare graphs.
A file exporting a single symbol renders as the symbol node, with the file name as quiet context.

conflicts.resolution: Newer direct dictation wins: folder boxes may be larger; symbol/file boxes stay uniform within kind.

shape.appetite: Medium: client view model, layout, canvas only; no server or contract change.
shape.problem: Mid-level focus views are wide strips with piled edges, folders look like files, size is invisible, and neighbors are not grouped.
success_moves: Join LOC/metrics client-side by absPath from the treemap tree instead of extending DepGraphNode (no payload or build-time cost)
Keep the uniform-cell grid router; show folder size with an in-box size bar (row spans would block gutters and break the free-gutter invariant, layout.ts:9-10)
Group keys from existing hierarchy; barycenter at group level then within group
Geometry tests gate each slice: aspect band, zero box crossings, group contiguity, crossing count
Local gitignored modeler fixtures for realism; committed tests use srcly fixture plus synthetic graphs (public repo)

first_proof.question: Do aspect-targeted packing, two-line boxes and grouping make mid-level views readable without breaking routing?
first_proof.artifact: layout/viewModel changes plus geometry tests on srcly fixture and local modeler server/ and components/ graphs; before/after screenshots
first_proof.observation: aspect within 0.5-2x viewport, 0 node crossings, groups contiguous, crossings not worse than baseline
first_proof.decision_rule: pass -> folder row-span, color join, edge spread; grouping raises crossings >~25% -> group labels without contiguity and revisit

rabbit_holes: row spans blocking gutters (moved to evaluate; size bar is the plan)
per-column frames looking fragmented when a group spans depth levels
compare graph regressions via shared layoutViewSync
two-line height reducing boxes that fit the budget
